title: Your Roach Has 40 Babies 🪳 (Things Living In Your House #46)
pinned_comment: Be honest: have you ever seen a roach carrying its egg case? 👀 Where was it?

source_quotes.uky: Several nymphs emerge from each egg case (up to 40 with the German cockroach, 15-20 with other varieties). / Cockroaches will eat all human foods, plus many other items such as soap, toothpaste, glue, hair, excrement, and filth.
source_quotes.ucipm: An adult female cockroach produces an egg case, called an ootheca, which it carries around protruding from the tip of the abdomen. / Adult German cockroaches can hide in a crack 1/16 inch wide.
source_quotes.psu: Each capsule contains up to 48 eggs (usually 30 to 48) ... Egg capsules are carried, protruding from the abdomen, until hatching time. / During the day, they hide in cracks and crevices.
source_quotes.sciam: Headless roaches are capable of living for weeks. (Fact or Fiction?: A Cockroach Can Live without Its Head, Charles Choi, 2007)

youtube.t: Meatball, you see that roach? It's carrying 40 babies!

youtube.t: Too slow. It fits in a sixteenth-inch crack.
